summary.text: Linda Trujillo is a Democrat who represents District 24 in Santa Fe County in the New Mexico Senate and is the Senate Majority Floor Leader.
The legislature's member page lists Trujillo as a representative from 2017 to 2020 and a senator since 2025, and as a member of the Senate Finance Committee.

paragraphs.text: The legislature's member page lists Trujillo's occupation as attorney.

Between sessions, Trujillo chairs the Mortgage Finance Authority Act Oversight Committee and is a member of the Legislative Finance Committee and the Federal Funding Stabilization and Affordability Subcommittee.
